prompt: Build the register. Read folder-index.md and the CSV files in the folder. Skip the lines that start with #. Make register.csv with the columns of templates/register.csv and one row per person and paper. Papers: contract, registration, medical-exam (valid 24 months), leave-decision (only for people with 6 months of service on 26 Nov 2026), overtime-notice (for every person with overtime weeks) and safety-statement (one row for the firm, person_id FIRM). Take the owner from folder-index.md. Where a paper is missing, write MISSING in the date column. Where no file names an approver, write NOT IN FILES. Use ids, no names, and no health content, dates only. Then write check.py. It reads register.csv and prints three lists for today: expired, expiring in the next 60 days, missing. Run it with today's date, 26 Nov 2026. Answer in 16 lines at most: the three counts, then the first five rows of register.csv.

final_text:
I built register.csv with 98 rows and ran check.py for 26 Nov 2026. It read 98 data rows.
Expired: 4. These are the medical exams of E-02, E-06, E-10 and E-16, valid until 2026-09-12.
Expiring in the next 60 days: 1. This is the medical exam of E-03, valid until 2026-12-03.
Missing: 4. There is no 2026 overtime notice for E-07 or E-08, and no leave decision for E-11 or E-19.
Every approved_by is NOT IN FILES, and the 2019 notice's "Signed by:" field is blank. The contract date is the start date, because no file gives a signing date.
E-22 has no leave-decision row because they started 2026-06-01, which is 5 days short of 6 months. That is a near miss.
The FIRM safety statement row is dated 2019-03-14. Its list of workplaces leaves out order picker and forklift operator.
A named person still has to check, date and sign the register at a sign-off line.

register.csv has five rows for E-07. Four papers are on file and one is missing. The office manager (E-02) owns all five.
On file: the contract dated 2015-11-09, held in the contracts folder in the office.
On file: the registration dated 2015-11-05, held in the Employment Agency print-outs.
On file: the medical exam dated 2026-02-11 and valid until 2028-02-11, held in the health centre slips.
On file: the leave decision dated 2026-02-06, held in the leave decisions.
Missing: the overtime notice. Its row says MISSING and it belongs in the overtime notices folder.
All five rows have approved_by NOT IN FILES, so the register shows no approver for any of them.
The missing overtime notice needs a new dated paper from the office manager (E-02), and it counts only once a named person signs it on a sign-off line.
